issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares the Farm.animals attribute as private (aggregation: "- animals: List<Animal]"), while the solution implementation declares the field as public (public List<Animal> animals;). This visibility mismatch deviates from the UML/specification and may confuse students who expect the attribute to be private with access through the getter/setter as described in the task.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the animals field private in Farm (private List<Animal> animals;) to match the UML and the task description, and keep the provided getter and setter for external access. This preserves encapsulation and aligns the implementation with the specification.
